title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
shortTitle: Journey to the Center of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
blurb:
It will forever be funny that the most popular edition of this novel on Project Gutenberg will forever be the mangled rewritten edition, only because of a title change.
Oh Verne. Why is your translation history such a mess?
blurb2: The chud George Orwell "Like most writers, Jules Verne was one of those people to whom nothing ever happens." (link) vs the chad Extraordinary Adventures "Everything he wrote about in his novels, Jules Verne actually experienced first-hand." (link). (Also from that same Orwell essay: "one can see the justification for Hitler". Real, and taken only moderately out-of-context.)
